# Luna Dreyer

> Melbourne agency helping Australians buy property in Europe without travelling. We prepare the power of attorney to the overseas notary's wording, book an Australian Notary Public within the week, take the document to DFAT for the apostille ourselves, and liaise with the agent, lawyer and notary in Italy, Spain, Greece, Portugal, Cyprus, Malta and Germany in their language. Founder trained in translation at Heidelberg University.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lunadreyer.com.au/): Buying property in Europe from Australia: power of attorney signed within the week, DFAT apostille done by us, one contact for the agent, lawyer and notary overseas.

Choose the country (Italy, Spain, Portugal, Greece, Cyprus, Malta, Germany), the purpose (buying, auction, selling, inheritance) and the deed date to see every step of a power of attorney from Australia, the day to start, the DFAT apostille fee and what the overseas notary needs.
- [Mallorca and the Balearic Islands](https://lunadreyer.com.au/mallorca-balearic-islands.html): Buying property in Mallorca, Menorca, Ibiza or Formentera from Australia. The agency prepares the power of attorney in Australia within the week; Carmen, its partner in Mallorca, arranges the notario, building inspections, negotiations, insurance calls and concierge help on the island, is a native Mallorquín speaker for direct talks with local owners and sellers, and a translator in German, Spanish and Catalan.
